p: One who performs a task with … water of purification, … or with … heifer of purification,

One who performs a task with the water of purification, i.e., the water that is mixed with the ashes of the red heifer and sprinkled upon one who has become impure as part of the purification ritual, or with the red heifer of purification,
exempt according to human laws, … but
exempt according to human laws, since he has not caused any discernible damage, but
liable according to the laws of Heaven. … a task … since the damage … is not evident,

liable according to the laws of Heaven. It may be inferred from here that one is exempt from liability according to human laws only if he performed a task with those items, since the damage that he caused is not evident,
indeed liable according to human laws.
